text_block_list.text:
A few months after her Make Debut. Worried 
about a downhearted Mayano Top Gun, the 
Trainer brings her out to the racetrack.

Upon arriving at the racetrack, Mayano Top 
Gun complains to her Trainer that the race 
she actually ran was far from ideal and 
"totally boring."

To clear her frustration, the Trainer 
decides to let her take on races where her 
talent can truly shine.
